headline: PicPay Shares Plunge 28% in New York Following Q3 Results and Guidance Revision
summary: Brazilian fintech PicPay saw its stock tumble 28% in New York despite reporting a 157% rise in Q3 net profit to R$271 million. Selling was triggered by guidance revisions and shortened credit write-off schedules.
why: PicPay is a major digital financial services and payments platform in Brazil.

impacts.name: PicPay
impacts.why: Disappointing guidance and credit provision adjustments sparked aggressive selling in PicPay equity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: PicPay stock dropped almost 30% after management reduced guidance and altered write-off timing for delinquent loans.
